<translated_code>
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct CF1187G {
    static const int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    struct Edge {
        int u, v, capacity, cost, rev;
        Edge(int u, int v, int capacity, int cost, int rev)
            : u(u), v(v), capacity(capacity), cost(cost), rev(rev) {}
    };
    int n, m, k, c, d;
    vector<vector<Edge>> graph;
    vector<int> pi, dd, bb, qq;
    vector<bool> inQueue;
    vector<int> uu, vv, uv, costEdges;
    vector<int> cc;
    int S, T;
    int nodeCount;
    int maxFlowCost;

    CF1187G() {}

    void addEdge(int u, int v, int capacity, int cost) {
        graph[u].push_back({u, v, capacity, cost, (int)graph[v].size()});
        graph[v].push_back({v, u, 0, -cost, (int)graph[u].size() - 1});
    }

    bool spfa() {
        std::fill(pi.begin(), pi.end(), INF);
        pi[S] = 0;
        std::fill(dd.begin(), dd.end(), 0);
        std::fill(inQueue.begin(), inQueue.end(), false);
        int head = 0, tail = 0;
        qq[tail++] = S;
        inQueue[S] = true;
        while (head < tail) {
            int u = qq[head++];
            inQueue[u] = false;
            for (int i = 0; i < (int)graph[u].size(); ++i) {
                const auto &e = graph[u][i];
                if (e.capacity > 0 && pi[e.v] > pi[u] + e.cost) {
                    pi[e.v] = pi[u] + e.cost;
                    dd[e.v] = dd[u] + 1;
                    bb[e.v] = i;
                    if (!inQueue[e.v]) {
                        inQueue[e.v] = true;
                        qq[tail++] = e.v;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return pi[T] != INF;
    }

    int sendFlow(int u, int flow) {
        if (u == T) {
            maxFlowCost += flow * pi[T];
            return flow;
        }
        int totalSent = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)graph[u].size(); ++i) {
            auto &e = graph[u][i];
            if (e.capacity > 0 && pi[e.v] == pi[u] + e.cost) {
                int pushed = sendFlow(e.v, std::min(flow - totalSent, e.capacity));
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    e.capacity -= pushed;
                    graph[e.v][e.rev].capacity += pushed;
                    totalSent += pushed;
                    if (totalSent == flow) break;
                }
            }
        }
        return totalSent;
    }

    int minCostMaxFlow() {
        maxFlowCost = 0;
        while (spfa()) {
            sendFlow(S, INT_MAX);
        }
        return maxFlowCost;
    }

    void run() {
        ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
        cin.tie(nullptr);
        int n, m_, k_, c_, d_;
        cin >> n >> m_ >> k_ >> c_ >> d_;
        vector<int> ii(k_);
        for (int i = 0; i < k_; ++i) {
            cin >> ii[i];
            --ii[i];
        }
        vector<vector<int>> aa(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < m_; ++i) {
            int u, v;
            cin >> u >> v;
            --u; --v;
            aa[u].push_back(v);
            aa[v].push_back(u);
        }

        // Calculate total nodes
        int t = n + k_ + 1;
        nodeCount = n * t + 1;
        int totalEdges = k_ + (m_ * 2 * k_ + n) * (t - 1);

        S = nodeCount - 1;
        T = nodeCount - 1; // Will be redefined below

        graph.assign(nodeCount, {});
        pi.assign(nodeCount, 0);
        dd.assign(nodeCount, 0);
        bb.assign(nodeCount, 0);
        inQueue.assign(nodeCount, false);
        qq.assign(nodeCount, 0);
        uv.assign(totalEdges, 0);
        vv.assign(totalEdges, 0);
        cc.assign(totalEdges * 2, 0);
        costEdges.assign(totalEdges, 0);

        int edgeIdx = 0;
        // Build the layered graph with capacity and costs
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int s = 0; s < t -1; ++s) {
                int u = i * t + s;
                for (int j : aa[i]) {
                    int v = j * t + s +1;
                    for (int x=1; x<=k_; ++x) {
                        addEdge(u, v, 1, c_ + (x * 2 -1) * d_);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Add edges between layers
        for (int i=0; i<n; ++i) {
            for (int s=0; s<t-1; ++s) {
                int u = i*t + s;
                int v = u +1;
                addEdge(u, v, k_, (i==0)?0:c_);
            }
        }

        // Connect source to initial nodes
        for (int h=0; h<k_; ++h) {
            addEdge(T, ii[h]*t + 0, 1, 0);
        }

        // Set source and sink for min cost max flow
        // The last node is source, last is sink
        int source = T;
        int sink = 0 * t + t - 1;
        S = source;
        T = sink;

        int answer = minCostMaxFlow();
        cout << answer << "\n";
    }
};

int main() {
    CF1187G solver;
    solver.run();
    return 0;
}
